records.title: CAPS: Cascaded Adaptive Pairwise Selection for Efficient Parallel Reasoning
records.reason: CAPS cascades adaptive pairwise selection to cut the heavy verification cost of parallel reasoning aggregation at test time; it reduces inference-time compute of a reasoning procedure, but as an algorithmic selection scheme rather than a serving system, so borderline.

records.title: Concatenated Matrix SVD: Compression Bounds, Incremental Approximation, and Error-Constrained Clustering
records.reason: Concatenated matrix SVD is analyzed for compression bounds and incremental approximation across matrix collections including neural network compression; generic numerical compression theory with only partial relevance to model inference, hence borderline.

records.title: Offline Exploration-Aware Fine-Tuning for Long-Chain Mathematical Reasoning
records.reason: Exploration-aware supervised fine-tuning shapes the initialization for RL with verifiable rewards on long-chain math reasoning; a training method with no inference mechanism.

records.title: Hawk: Harnessing Hardware-Aware Knowledge for High-Performance NPU Kernel Generation
records.reason: Hawk retrieves hardware-aware knowledge so LLMs can generate high-performance NPU kernels without violating memory hierarchies; the LLM is a code-generation tool and the product is kernel-development automation, adjacent to inference kernels but not an inference system, so borderline.

records.title: Persistent Memory Through Triple-Loop Consolidation in a Non-Gradient Dissipative Cognitive Architecture
records.reason: Triple-loop consolidation maintains persistent memory in a non-gradient dissipative cognitive architecture whose units are stochastically replaced; an alternative cognitive architecture unrelated to LLM inference systems.

records.title: Hierarchical Long-Term Semantic Memory for LinkedIn's Hiring Agent
records.reason: A hierarchical long-term semantic memory system for LinkedIn's hiring agent extracts structured signals and supports low-latency retrieval at industrial scale; a production agent-memory system, but its contribution is memory quality for one application rather than LLM serving, so borderline.

records.title: OS-Pruner: Pruning Chains-of-Thought of Reasoning Models via Optimal Stopping
records.reason: OS-Pruner prunes chains of thought in reasoning models via optimal stopping, avoiding static budgets and retraining while cutting latency and cost of redundant reasoning steps; a concrete inference-time reasoning-length optimization, hence accept.

records.title: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B: Attributed Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Memory Writing
records.reason: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B is a specialized model trained with attributed RL to execute memory write paths across external-memory frameworks, lowering reliance on general LLM writers; memory-writing specialization with a serving-cost motivation, but the contribution is a trained writer model, so borderline.

records.title: Evolving Attention with Residual Convolutions
records.reason: Evolving attention propagates attention maps across layers through residual convolutions to improve transformer accuracy on NLP and vision; an accuracy-oriented architecture change with no inference efficiency claim.

records.title: Pointer: Constrained Text Generation via Insertion-based Generative Pre-training
records.reason: POINTER generates lexically constrained text by progressive parallel insertion with a pretrained transformer; a constrained generation method from the BERT/GPT-2 era with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Parallel Training of Deep Networks with Local Updates
records.reason: Local-update parallel training removes synchronization across deep network blocks to parallelize training on large datasets; a training parallelization method, explicitly not inference.

records.title: Parallel Test-Time Scaling for Latent Reasoning Models
records.reason: Parallel test-time scaling is extended to latent reasoning models by adding sampling mechanisms in continuous reasoning space; an inference-time algorithmic scaling study without serving, decoding-system or efficiency mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: Quantization Robust Federated Learning for Efficient Inference on Heterogeneous Devices
records.reason: Quantization-robust federated learning trains models that can be deployed at varied bit-widths for efficient inference on heterogeneous devices; the core contribution is federated training robustness, with inference efficiency as a deployment property, hence borderline.

records.title: Unextractable Protocol Models: Collaborative Training and Inference without Weight Materialization
records.reason: Unextractable Protocol Models shard a large network across mutually distrusting participants so full weights never materialize during collaborative training and serving; a decentralized trust framework whose inference aspect is inseparable from its training protocol, so borderline.

records.title: Hardware and Software Platform Inference
records.reason: This work shows buyers of hosted LLM inference cannot verify the advertised model or H100-class hardware and studies fingerprinting of the serving platform; measurement of inference services rather than a serving mechanism, hence borderline.

records.title: BCEdge: SLO-Aware DNN Inference Services With Adaptive Batch-Concurrent Scheduling on Edge Devices
records.reason: BCEdge schedules multiple DNN inference services on edge devices with adaptive batch-concurrency under SLOs; edge DNN serving scheduling is close to the scope, but the models and evaluation are generic DNNs rather than LLM inference, so borderline.

records.title: Deep Fusion: Efficient Network Training via Pre-trained Initializations
records.reason: Deep Fusion grows networks from pretrained initializations to cut deep network training cost, studying the mechanism of network growing; a training efficiency method with no inference contribution.

records.title: Towards Inference-time Scaling for Continuous Space Reasoning
records.reason: Dropout-based sampling plus reward-model reranking is adapted to COCONUT continuous-space reasoning for inference-time scaling; an algorithmic test-time study without a serving or decoding-system mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: End-to-End Agentic RAG System Training for Traceable Diagnostic Reasoning
records.reason: Deep-DxSearch trains an agentic RAG system end-to-end with RL for traceable clinical diagnostic reasoning; a healthcare application of LLM agents with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: ENGRAM: Effective, Lightweight Memory Orchestration for Conversational Agents
records.reason: ENGRAM is a deliberately lightweight memory orchestration system giving conversational agents long-horizon consistency without knowledge-graph pipelines; agent memory infrastructure that shapes inference-time context, but focused on memory simplicity rather than serving efficiency, so borderline.
